expression_source: UCSC Xena GDC hub, TCGA-SKCM STAR-FPKM
patient_deduplication: prefer sample code 06, then 07, then 01; lexical sample-ID tie-break
gene_standardization: within all selected tumors, gene-wise Z-score, ddof=0
ortholog_weight_rule: split each mouse-gene weight equally across all expressed human orthologs, then renormalize covered weights within each source program
program_standardization: within all selected tumors, Z-score, ddof=0
